Name: Glowing Pets - Pets Glow at Night for Visibility
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Glowing Pets
[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Never lose your furry friend in the dark again.[/i][/size][/center]
[line][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3][/size][/center][center][/center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements
[/url][/size]
[size=5][b]Description
[/b][/size]
Have you ever walked back to your farmhouse at night and tripped over your pet because you couldn't see them? [b]Glowing Pets[/b] attaches a gentle, dynamic light source to your pet (Cat, Dog, or Turtle) that activates automatically when the sun goes down.

It serves as a cute aesthetic addition and a practical way to keep track of your companion during late-night farm chores.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41304/41304-1768530398-943450667.png[/img]﻿[/center]


[size=5][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Adaptive Timing:[/b] The mod detects when sunset occurs in your game. If you use mods that change the length of the day or the time of sunset, this mod adapts automatically.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Late Activation:[/b] Optional setting to delay the light until it is truly dark (2 hours after sunset), rather than turning on immediately at dusk.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Performance Friendly:[/b] The light only renders when you are in the same location as your pet.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Fully Configurable:[/b] Change the color, intensity, timing, and size of the light.
[/list][center]﻿[/center]
[center][/center][size=5][b]Color Presets
[/b][/size]
You can switch between different lighting modes in the config:

[list]
[*] [b]Normal (Default)[/b].
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Moonlight:[/b] A cool, calming yellow light that blends well with the night.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Spooky:[/b] An eerie red glow, perfect for Spirit's Eve.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Custom:[/b] Pick your own Red, Green, and Blue values to match your pet's personality.
[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41304/41304-1768530397-886399644.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=5][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
The mod works out of the box with the [b]Normal[/b] preset and [b]Late Activation[/b] enabled.

You can adjust these settings by editing the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file created after the first launch, or by using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (highly recommended).

[b]Options include:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enabled:[/b] Toggle the mod on/off.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Late Activation:[/b] If set to [b]true[/b], the light turns on 2 hours after sunset (e.g., 8:00 PM). If [b]false[/b], it turns on exactly at sunset (e.g., 6:00 PM).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Preset:[/b] Choose between Normal, Moonlight, Spooky, or Custom.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Light Radius:[/b] How large the glow area is (0.5 to 4.0).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Custom Colors:[/b] RGB sliders (0-255) for precise color control.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*] Download this mod.
[*] Unzip the folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*] Run the game.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[*] Works in Single Player and Multiplayer.
[*] Compatible with mods that alter game time or sunset hours.
[*] Recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy in-game configuration.
[/list]
